title: Injectivity of the first Cech cohomology map
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let U = {U_i} be an open covering of X. For every sheaf H of O_X-modules, the canonical homomorphism c_H from the first Cech cohomology group of U with values in the underlying abelian sheaf of H to H^1(X,H) is injective; this is the canonical map for the underlying abelian sheaf in the Cech-to-cohomology comparison.

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-cech-h1-map-natural] to obtain the canonical degree-one comparison maps c_F and their IsModuleCechComparison equations. Fix a coefficient module F and one injective resolution I. Use the module-valued Cech double complex and beta augmentation of [def-sc-module-cech-comparison]; its augmentation a into resolution degree zero satisfies a composed with the resolution differential equals zero by functoriality.

By [lem-sc-module-cech-resolution-column-zero], the augmentation in every Cech degree is a degree-zero quasi-isomorphism from a single complex. Mathlib CochainComplex.quasiIsoAt₀_iff, ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros, and exact_and_mono_f_iff_f_is_kernel turn this into the kernel universal property for a.f n, including monomorphy.

Prove H¹(beta) monomorphic by Mathlib HomologicalComplex.mono_homologyMap_iff_up_to_refinements. Given a cycle z and total primitive t for beta(z), total degree zero consists only of (0,0). Write t=t₀ followed by that inclusion. Project the boundary equality to (1,0): t₀ followed by the resolution differential is zero. The degree-zero column kernel lifts t₀ to x in A.X 0. Project the equality to (0,1): z followed by a.f 1 is t₀ followed by the Cech differential. Naturality of a and monomorphy of a.f 1 give z=x followed by A.d 0 1. Take the identity refinement. The total signs on (0,0) are both +1. All projection, differential and boundary-lifting helpers are completely proved private lemmas in the delivered module.

Apply the IsModuleCechComparison equation from [lem-sc-cech-h1-map-natural] at I: c_F followed by the resolution identification and H¹(alpha) equals H¹(beta). Since this composite is monomorphic, Mathlib mono_of_mono_fac makes c_F monomorphic. ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective gives the required underlying-function injectivity. No module/abelian comparison or Cech spectral-sequence identification is needed.
